summary:
## RAG with Open WebUI

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (**RAG**) allows you to chat with your documents. In **Open WebUI**, this is managed through a document system accessible from the admin portal.

## Setting Up Your Document Knowledge Base

The primary setup happens in the admin console:

1.  Navigate to the **Workspace** tab.
2.  Select the **Documents** sub-tab.
3.  This area is where you upload and manage all documents for RAG.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Use **tags** (hashtags) to organize your documents into logical groups (e.g., `HR-policies`, `marketing-reports`). Proper tagging is crucial for managing and retrieving documents efficiently, especially with a large number of files.

## Two Ways to Perform RAG

You can interact with your documents in two distinct ways:

### 1. Manual (One-Off) Chat
*   **How it works:** Use the upload button directly within a chat session to add a document for a single conversation.
*   **Best for:** Quick, one-time questions about a specific document that doesn't need to be part of the permanent knowledge base.

### 2. Persistent Document Collections
*   **How it works:** In the chat prompt, type the `#` character to bring up a list of your pre-uploaded, tagged document collections. Select a tag (e.g., `#marketing`) to provide all documents with that tag as context for your query.
*   **Best for:** Creating a long-term, queryable knowledge base that users can access repeatedly.

## Key Considerations & Limitations

> [!TIP]
> When an admin adds new documents or tags, **users must refresh their web UI page** to see the new collections available with the `#` command.

> [!NOTE]
> Open WebUI's RAG implementation is **text-only**. It performs basic text extraction from your documents but **cannot** process information contained in images, charts, or graphs. For best results, use documents with high-quality, text-based content.
